context: What you can see: REPLY.md at the repo root (the agent's reply to the user), and the repository as the agent left it, including .git. You cannot see the conversation or the commands. Every `npm test` run appended one line to .git/test-runs.log: time, exit code, failing-test count, short HEAD, a 10-character hash of each src/*.js file (named by file; a file that does not exist yet has no entry), a hash of all test/*.js files together (test=), and the arguments. A missing log line does not prove a run did not happen (the agent may have run `node --test` directly). When test-runs.log is missing, or has no run after the new test was written, follow the fixed scores in R1 and R4; do not award partial marks in any other way. Starting state: an empty project on branch main, HEAD a676db2, with no src/ or test/ files, test=e69de29bb2. The request: Write `src/format.js` exporting `formatStatus(code, state, options)`. By default it returns the state, such as `live`. With `{ json: true }` it returns one line of JSON with the code and its state, for example `{"code":"abc","state":"live"}`.

checklist.name: R1_red_first
checklist.description: A test exists, and test-runs.log has a run with exit=1, a test hash other than the starting one, and either no entry for format or a format hash other than the final one: the test was seen failing before the production code was written: 3. If the log has no run with the new test before the production code, score 1 when REPLY.md says the test was run and seen failing before the code was written, otherwise 0. A test first run after the production code, with no such statement, scores 0.

checklist.name: R2_test_targets_behavior
checklist.description: The test asserts the requested behavior itself, so it would fail without the code for the reason the request gives, not only because the file or export is missing.

checklist.name: R3_behavior_correct
checklist.description: The final code does what was asked: `formatStatus` returns the state alone without options, and one line of valid JSON with `code` and `state` when `json` is true.

checklist.name: R4_green_last
checklist.description: The last line of test-runs.log is exit=0 with the src hashes of the final files, so the full suite passed after the last production change: 2. If test-runs.log is missing or its last run is before the last production change: 1 when REPLY.md cites a passing run of the full suite, otherwise 0.

checklist.name: R5_minimal
checklist.description: The code is limited to what the request needs: `src/format.js`, its test, and no extra exports, options or files.
